content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: IIT Gandhinagar is located at Palaj Campus, Gandhinagar, Gujarat. The notice is issued by its Finance & Accounts Office for two contractual positions of Program Assistant I. The posts are not regular appointments; the notice describes them as contractual.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: B.Com./BBA (Finance) or equivalent qualifications in Accounts and Finance discipline. A minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from Graduation onwards, and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th. Knowledge of the current version of Tally or such other accounting software. All qualifications must be obtained from recognized Indian universities or institutes approved by AICTE or other appropriate statutory authorities. Experience in a Higher Education Institute in the Finance & Accounts area will be preferred. The age limit is 35 years as on the last date of submitting the application. Relaxation in age and/or educational qualifications may be considered for exceptionally meritorious candidates, subject to prior approval. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly remuneration is Rs. 28,000/- to Rs. 53,000/- per month, based on the qualification and experience of the candidate. The tenure is 01 year, extendable on an annual basis subject to the candidate's yearly performance and assessment. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances.

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Program Assistant I Job Description
content_sections.text: The Program Assistant-I will work on the daily accounting work in the F&A section. The selected candidate will be responsible for preparing journal and payment vouchers, processing various claims, bank reconciliation, maintaining the financial & accounting records, recordkeeping, managing communications, etc. He/She should have a sound knowledge of the accounting function and should be able to work in collaboration with faculty/staff of IITGN. The selected candidate may be assigned any other work by the competent authority, as and when required on need basis.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Gandhinagar Program Assistant I
content_sections.text: Open the application link titled "Applications for Program Assistant I- 11/2026" given in the notice (see Important Links below). Submit the application by 8 December 2026. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. If shortlisted, bring the original documents along with self-attested photocopies at the time of the written test and/or interview. Original documents Self-attested photocopies of PAN card Mark sheets Academic certificates Testimonials of work experience, etc.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: All applications will be scrutinized, and only shortlisted candidates possessing superior qualifications and relevant experience will be invited for the written test and/or interview. Meeting the minimum qualifications and eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for an interview. The selection process may consist of a written test followed by a personal interview, conducted at the IIT Gandhinagar campus. The dates of the test or interview are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: IIT Gandhinagar reserves the right to not call any applicant for an interview without assigning any reason. A candidature is liable to be rejected at any stage, or after appointment, if any information furnished is found to be false, misleading or inconsistent with the eligibility criteria. IIT Gandhinagar reserves the right to cancel, restrict, enlarge, modify or alter the recruitment process without prior notice and without assigning any reason. IIT Gandhinagar reserves the right not to fill any of the advertised posts. No interim correspondence will be entertained. Canvassing in any form will lead to automatic disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. How many Program Assistant I posts are vacant at IIT Gandhinagar?

faq.answer: The last date of application submission is 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IIT Gandhinagar Program Assistant I?
faq.answer: B.Com./BBA (Finance) or equivalent qualifications in Accounts and Finance discipline, with a minimum of 60% or equivalent grade from Graduation onwards and 55% or equivalent grade in class 10th and 12th, plus knowledge of the current version of Tally or such other accounting software.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for IIT Gandhinagar Program Assistant I?

faq.answer: Apply through the link "Applications for Program Assistant I- 11/2026" given in the notice, before 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for IIT Gandhinagar Program Assistant I?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinized and only shortlisted candidates are invited for a written test and/or interview. The selection process may consist of a written test followed by a personal interview at the IIT Gandhinagar campus.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIT Gandhinagar Program Assistant I job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are contractual, with a tenure of 01 year that is extendable on an annual basis subject to the candidate's yearly performance and assessment.

faq.answer: Relaxation in age and/or educational qualifications may be considered in the case of exceptionally meritorious candidates, subject to prior approval.

faq.answer: They must produce their original documents along with self-attested photocopies of PAN card, mark sheets, academic certificates and testimonials of work experience at the time of the written test and/or interview.
